title: Historic Boat Charter on Lake Union, Seattle.
markdown:
# Embark on an Charter Adventure around Historic Lake Union!

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/02505a5c-7f63-4ba0-bed4-57267f496e5c/1000007463.jpg)

Cruise Lake Union in one of our historical vessels. Your USCG-licensed captain will give you a tour of historic Lake Union — the Seattle skyline, Gas Works Park, Lake Union Drydock Company, and the floating homes. Bring your own food and beverages (alcohol allowed on the boat, not on the docks); well-behaved dogs are encouraged to join. Call the front desk with special requests and we'll do our best to accommodate.

## As of October 1, 2025, all CWB adult programing and boat rentals are now subject to Washington state sales tax.

### Details:

- **Ages:** All ages welcome
- **Season:** April through September
- **Price:** $280 members / $350 non-members
- **Passengers:** 4 ideal, 6 maximum
- **Length:** Typically 90 minutes; flexible schedule
- **Booking:** [Book online](https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule/240b651c/appointment/78949360/calendar/12208789?calendarIds=12208789) and choose your time
- **Captain:** CWB USCG Licensed Captains

[Book here!](https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule.php?owner=29574902&calendarID=12208789)

### ABOUT THE BOAT

BOAT HOUSE NO. 5, a Bill Garden design, is one of our most beloved vessels. Originally built by Gordon Lacey in Brentwood Bay as a salmon fishing launch, this fully restored classic wood pocket cruiser has a small cabin and aft seating for up to 6 passengers — perfect for a lovely afternoon or evening picnic on the lake, and a stunning example of Bill Garden's work.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

**How do I book a charter cruise?**
Book online at least 24 hours in advance so a captain can be scheduled, or call the office Wednesday–Sunday during business hours at (206) 382-2628. Bookings within 24 hours may be possible by speaking with front desk staff on-site or calling during business hours.

**Are life jackets required?**
No. Type 1 Personal Flotation Devices (PFDs) are easily accessible on board.

**Is food and drink allowed on the boat?**
Yes — bring whatever you like. Alcohol is permitted on the boat but not on the docks. Please pack out what you pack in.

**Is there a restroom on board?**
No. Restrooms are available at the education center when you check in; plan ahead or ask your captain before departure.

**Can I bring my dog?**
Yes, well-behaved dogs are welcome. Dog life jackets are available but not required. Dogs must be leashed on the docks.

## CANCELLATION POLICY

Cancellations or no-shows within 48 hours of the scheduled time are charged 100% of the full non-member rate. Captains and vessels are held for each booking, and last-minute changes are hard to fill, reducing chances for others to sail.
